title: HIPAA & Patient Data Privacy (2026)
description: Mandatory healthcare data security compliance covering Protected Health Information (PHI), encryption standards, and breach reporting under HHS OCR.

videos.title: Part 1: PHI Identification & Minimum Necessary Rule
Part 3: Breach Notification & Incident Response Protocols

questions.prompt: Under HIPAA regulations, which of the following is legally classified as Protected Health Information (PHI)?
options: Patient IP address, medical record number, and billing logs
Public healthcare provider directory phone numbers
questions.answerKey: Patient IP address, medical record number, and billing logs

questions.prompt: What is the mandatory federal reporting window for a security breach affecting 500 or more individuals?
options: Without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days
Notification is only required if ransomware was deployed
questions.answerKey: Without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days

questions.prompt: Briefly state the core objective of the HIPAA 'Minimum Necessary' standard.
questions.modelAnswer: Staff must only access and disclose the minimum amount of PHI strictly necessary to fulfill the intended job function.

questions.prompt: What is the standard employee EPF contribution rate applied to eligible basic wages?
Under statutory tax compliance, on what schedule must monthly TDS withheld from employees be remitted to the government?
